purpose: Freeze the noncompensatory independent re-audit of a prospective V5 protocol whose sole scientific repair is PV4-EDGE-B001, the previously undefined mean/variance-rescale-only SO/spindle event veto. The plan also freezes exact regression checks proving that every unrelated V4 scientific and governance choice remains unchanged.

source_precedence: Exact V4 protocol and artifact bytes define the regression baseline.
V4_EDGE_SEMANTICS_ADJUDICATION defines the only authorized scientific repair and the unchanged all-missing-bootstrap interpretation.
Corrected implementation-release controls define outcome blindness and closed execution gates.

plan_immutability.activation: This plan is externally SHA-256 hashed before any Candidate V5 artifact is opened, hashed, statted, or enumerated by the planner or assigned auditor.
plan_immutability.self_hash_policy: The final SHA-256 is reported externally and is not recursively embedded.
plan_immutability.change_rule: Any change after Candidate V5 disclosure requires a separately named re-audit-plan version; no criterion may be relaxed in response to V5 contents.
plan_immutability.no_self_release: This plan does not authorize V5 access, protocol audit, code access, implementation, preflight, repair, data, or scientific execution.

Exact immutable path and SHA-256 of the prospective V5 freeze manifest.
The complete explicit relative-path, byte-size, and SHA-256 list of every V5 artifact bound by that freeze, including every new or reused fixture.
An explicit stable-byte signal that all V5 propagation is complete and no further writes are planned.
An outcome-blind auditor assignment limited to the exact listed files.
future_reaudit_activation_gate.fail_closed: If any prerequisite is absent, mismatched, duplicated, path-escaping, case-colliding, mutable, or broader than the exact package, return NOT_AUTHORIZED_TO_AUDIT and do not open V5 content.
future_reaudit_activation_gate.audit_method_after_activation: Hash exact files first; only after every hash matches, parse exact JSON/Markdown and perform semantic comparisons. Do not enumerate directories, read code/manifests, import modules, execute Python/launcher/preflight, or access data/outcomes.

verdict_model.noncompensatory_rule: Every check family below must pass. Exactness in one field cannot compensate for ambiguity, omission, drift, or an unauthorized change elsewhere.
verdict_model.ambiguity_rule: The auditor never chooses a missing tolerance, estimator, event anchor, match window, tie rule, boundary convention, denominator, status, or fixture expectation. Any such choice not explicit in V5 is blocking.
verdict_model.pass_effect: Eligibility only for Root to consider a new outcome-blind V5 static implementation release. A PASS does not authorize code access, preflight, Phase2A, verifier execution, Phase2B, data, or outcomes.

sole_repair_scope.required_repair_summary: Replace the undefined V4 rescale-only SO/spindle event veto phrase with a complete, deterministic, context-bound paired raw-trace affine-normalization diagnostic and exact artifact-veto/status semantics.
allowed_semantic_changes: Exact raw-trace pairing and analysis-domain definition for the rescale diagnostic.
Exact affine intervention-to-sham normalization equations and operation order.
Exact finite, constant, zero-scale, degenerate, and invalid handling for that diagnostic.
Exact sham/intervention/affine-normalized three-way SO and spindle event matching, classification, aggregation, veto, and NOT_ESTIMABLE rules.
Exact rescale-diagnostic logging, output schema, and self-contained data-free fixture bindings.
Version, lineage, repair-scope, status, path, SHA-256, memo narrative, and cross-reference propagation mechanically required by those changes.
allowed_nonsemantic_propagation: V4 parent path/hash and V4 adjudication path/hash bindings
exact restatement of the adjudicated fail-closed all-missing-bootstrap rule without a new numeric convention
sole_repair_scope.forbidden_changes: Every other scientific value, formula, array, order, seed, RNG lifecycle, detector, metric, threshold, denominator, grid, policy, family, run identity, arithmetic, grade, gate, advancement, claim, Phase2B rule, or M1/C0/P0 boundary.
sole_repair_scope.repair_scope_assertion: Every V5 artifact that carries repair metadata must identify exactly PV4-EDGE-B001 and no other scientific finding.

V5R_I01_paired_raw_trace_identity.objective: Make the rescale diagnostic's two causal inputs exact and prevent cross-block or processed-signal substitution.
requirements: V5 names the exact sham raw trace and intervention raw trace, observation equation, dtype, stored sampling rate, sample-origin convention, analysis interval, half-open sample-index set, and required sample count before any centering, filtering, envelope, thresholding, event selection, or normalization.

Each pair is within one execution context, condition, parameter_draw_id, seed, initial state, 210 s duration, solver settings, stored-sample schedule, and complete OU innovation identity. The sham has all forcing channels zero.
No pairing across seed, draw, target, Level-A/Level-B/verifier context, condition, dose, carrier, repetition, policy candidate, or run duration is permitted.

V5 explicitly distinguishes raw observation traces from the existing per-run centered/filter-derived detector signals. A centered, filtered, z-scored, envelope, RMS, event-only, pooled, or summary input cannot silently replace a raw trace.
The raw-trace pair key, trace hashes, length, dtype, finite status, context, run IDs, draw, seed, and sham forcing status are required log/schema fields.

V5R_N01_affine_normalization_equations_a.objective: Require one exact intervention-to-sham affine normalization with no auditor-selected convention.

required_mathematical_form.direction: intervention moments are mapped to paired-sham moments; the sham is not mapped to the intervention
required_mathematical_form.auditor_equivalence_rule: An algebraically equivalent expression passes only if V5 fixes exactly the same estimators, index domain, float64 evaluation order, and degenerate branches and yields exact equality under the V5 fixtures.

requirements: V5 defines mu_S, mu_I, sigma_S, and sigma_I by exact equations, divisor/ddof, sample domain, accumulation dtype/order or canonical library call, square-root rule, and whether any recentering occurs after construction.

V5 fixes operation order relative to the existing common 180 s per-run centering, order-4 zero-phase filters, SO cycle detector, spindle RMS/envelope, sham-derived spindle thresholds, edge exclusion, and event-containment masks.

No clipping, winsorization, robust substitute, epsilon denominator, tolerance, rounding, alternate direction, nonlinear transform, per-window normalization, event-conditioned moments, or refitting is permitted unless explicitly prospectively specified by V5; any unspecified choice is blocking.

The normalized x_A is diagnostic-only. It cannot replace the official intervention trace for target metrics, scientific effects, policies, cross-target primitives, bootstrap members, or plots represented as primary outcomes.
The exact mu/sigma/a/b values and normalized-trace hash are required per pair in the diagnostic log and schema.

V5R_N02_degenerate_nonfinite_and_invalid.objective: Require exhaustive deterministic status branches before division or detection.
required_case_partition: both traces have required shape and all samples finite with sigma_I strictly positive
a computed moment, scale, coefficient, or normalized sample is nonfinite
trace shape, sample domain, pair identity, or raw-run validity fails
official sham or intervention run is already INVALID under frozen stability rules
requirements: V5 assigns one exact pre-detection status and downstream action to every case above, with raw float64 equality/tolerance semantics explicit. Cases cannot fall through to division, replacement, clipping, zero imputation, or successful veto clearance.

Existing solver/state INVALID status remains INVALID and is never downgraded to NOT_ESTIMABLE. A diagnostic that cannot be formed from otherwise valid runs must fail closed as NOT_ESTIMABLE for every dependent veto-clearance decision.

A constant finite bootstrap distribution is not an all-missing diagnostic and remains governed by the unchanged registered scale floor. The exact T4 ZERO_ADDED_BOOTSTRAP convention remains isolated to T4 attribution.
No degenerate branch may manufacture an empty-event success, infer absence of rescale artifact, or let a target, surface, cross-target policy row, Grade C, advancement, C2 gate, or claim pass.

V5R_D01_unchanged_official_detectors_and.objective: Ensure the repair diagnoses scaling without changing the official V4 detector.
requirements: The official SO and spindle preprocessing, filter order/bands, full-record filtering, edge exclusion, cycle/event definitions, thresholds, RMS support, duration/gap rules, strict containment, zero-event rules, and validity denominators are byte-semantic matches to V4.

Spindle high=sham median+3*MAD and low=sham median+1.5*MAD, with the existing MAD equation, are derived once from the original paired sham and applied unchanged to original intervention and affine-normalized diagnostic trace. No normalized-trace recalibration is allowed.
SO fixed event thresholds and all event boundary/extrema rules remain unchanged and are applied identically to sham, intervention, and normalized diagnostic traces.
The affine diagnostic cannot alter official sham thresholds, official intervention events, T2/T3/T4/T5 values, T4 attribution matching, T6/T7 event inputs, or T8 window events.

V5R_M01_three_way_event_matching.objective: Make the sham/original-intervention/affine-intervention event comparison complete, deterministic, and separate for SO and spindle events.
required_event_sets: E_S: events from the original paired sham under the unchanged official detector
E_I: events from the original paired intervention under the unchanged official detector
E_A: events from the affine-normalized intervention diagnostic trace under those same frozen detector settings and sham thresholds
requirements: V5 defines separate exact SO and spindle event anchors/keys, candidate-pair admissibility, maximum separation or overlap rule, units, strict versus inclusive comparisons, and analysis/edge/window boundary handling.

V5 defines one exact three-way algorithm or an exact ordered sequence of one-to-one pairings that identifies which E_I events are pre-existing versus E_S and which intervention-added events persist versus disappear in E_A.

Every candidate tuple sort key and tie breaker is total and ordered explicitly, including event onset, offset, detector extrema/peak, distance/overlap, and stable event ID. Equality at each threshold and boundary is resolved explicitly.

Matching is per paired block and event type only. No many-to-one match, rematch, amplitude-selected match, cross-block match, cross-context match, cross-window compression, or reuse of the T4 attribution matcher by unstated analogy is allowed.
Boundary-touching, cross-edge, invalid-support, and T8 cross-window events retain the existing rejection behavior and cannot enter the diagnostic through normalization or matching.

V5 explicitly defines the rescale-only class from the three-way match result and distinguishes it from a genuine morphology/timing-persistent added event, a pre-existing event, an event lost after intervention, and an unmatched/ambiguous invalid event.

The auditor independently recomputes every fixture candidate tuple, sorted order, accepted traversal, class, and consumption ledger from raw fixture tables; exact type/order/value equality is required.

V5R_P01_context_pooling_and_denominators.objective: Prevent a sparse or cross-context rescale diagnostic from borrowing evidence.
requirements: V5 defines the diagnostic unit, block key, event-type partition, execution-context partition, target/condition/policy partition, and aggregation order before any pooling.
All trace normalization and three-way event classification occurs within one exact draw-seed paired block. Events are never pooled before blockwise matching/classification.

No pooling or denominator borrowing across Level-A worker, conditional Level-B, cross-target verifier, target, condition, dose, carrier, repetition, requested mapping value, draw, seed, SO versus spindle, T4 attribution row, inactive policy alternative, or formal versus diagnostic use is permitted.

V5 specifies exact per-block minimum event support, complete-pair minimum, distinct-seed minimum, distinct-draw minimum, contributing-block definition, context-level numerator/denominator, aggregation statistic, equality rule, and missingness for every context in which the veto can clear or fire.

The existing complete-block floors remain lower bounds that cannot be weakened: Level A >=30 blocks, >=5 seeds, >=5 draws; Level B >=10 of 12 blocks, >=3 seeds, all 3 draws; verifier >=20 of 24 blocks, >=3 verifier seeds, >=5 draws. Existing target event minima also remain unchanged.

Inactive verifier alternatives remain NOT_LAUNCHED_BY_POLICY rather than missing and are never pooled. A context that lacks its complete diagnostic denominator is NOT_ESTIMABLE and cannot clear the off-target veto.

V5R_V01_veto_and_not_estimable_logic.objective: Make the repaired predicate's decision effect exact without creating a new benefit test.
requirements: V5 defines the exact Boolean/scalar condition for 'SO or spindle events appear only because the signal mean or variance is rescaled', including numerator, denominator, aggregation, threshold, strict/equality rule, event-type combination, and whether one failing block/context is sufficient or a context aggregate is required.
A determined rescale-only artifact fires the existing off-target veto and follows exact V5 failure/grade/gate consequences. It cannot be reported merely as a warning or descriptive flag.

An undefined raw pair, affine transform, detector result, match result, required denominator, or context aggregate yields NOT_ESTIMABLE for the dependent veto-clearance path. It never defaults to veto=false, zero artifact fraction, complete off-target passage, Grade C, advancement, C2-G8, or claim support.
Existing INVALID conditions remain INVALID. NOT_ESTIMABLE and INVALID are never interchangeable, and neither can pass.

The V4 all-missing-bootstrap adjudication is preserved exactly: an undefined required bootstrap object has no numerical band and fails closed NOT_ESTIMABLE; no skip, redraw, retry, zero, infinity, point estimate, family shrinkage, or generalized T4 zero-added convention is allowed.

V5 explicitly states which targets, Level-A conditions, conditional Level-B cells/mappings, and verifier policy cells require the diagnostic and proves that every affected route reaches the same noncompensatory veto/status logic.

V5R_U01_no_new_multiplicity_family.objective: Keep the rescale diagnostic as an artifact veto rather than an added inferential endpoint.
requirements: The repaired diagnostic is not a member of F_TARGET_DECISIONS, F_LEVEL_B_SURFACES, F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8, F_FORMAL_C2_INTERACTIONS, primary Holm, secondary Holm, or descriptive T8 sign-flip multiplicity.

All four simultaneous-family seeds, resampling lifecycles, exact member arrays/formulas, member counts, joint-statistic construction, quantile, scale floor, missing-member rules, and Holm/randomization rules remain semantically identical to V4.

F_TARGET_DECISIONS retains the exact V4 target member counts; F_LEVEL_B_SURFACES retains K=25*n25+20*n20+5*nmap<=80; F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 retains exactly 64 BENEFIT plus 64 ADVERSE members; formal C2 remains NOT_ESTIMABLE.

The diagnostic may gate whether an existing result is valid or estimable but cannot produce a new p-value, confidence band, bootstrap seed, family member, multiplicity adjustment, efficacy margin, or favorable scalar.

V5R_L01_logs_schemas_and_fixtures.objective: Make every repair decision independently reproducible before scientific execution.
required_log_semantics: pair/context/run identifiers and raw trace hashes
sample domain, count, dtype and finite/validity status
mu_S, mu_I, sigma_S, sigma_I, affine a and b, normalized trace hash
E_S, E_I and E_A event tables with anchors, boundaries and validity

block/context numerators, denominators, contributing blocks, aggregate, threshold and equality result

requirements: Every log field has an exact name, type, units, order or keyed-collection rule, nullability, enum, and schema binding. NaN/Infinity are not serialized as JSON numbers; their status is represented by exact finite-safe enums and null rules.

V5 supplies at least one self-contained, data-free, freeze-hash-bound raw-trace fixture for the rescale diagnostic. The fixture's raw and expected tables are sufficient for an independent implementation without external arrays or hidden generation.

Fixture coverage is noncompensatory for: pure mean shift, pure variance rescale, genuine event morphology/timing persistence after normalization, zero intervention scale, zero sham scale, both zero, nonfinite input, exact matcher tie, exact threshold equality, edge/boundary touch, unmatched event, per-block insufficiency, and context-pooling prohibition.

The fixture freezes exact raw inputs, all intermediate moments/coefficients/hashes, detector events, candidate/accepted matches, classes, denominators, final status, normalization rules, and a full-row-consumption comparison contract.

Any new fixture is explicitly bound by the V5 freeze and every internal reference with one exact SHA-256. The pre-existing T4 fixture remains byte-identical at 30402053094C0C1BCDEF87989D1D7DE3DD4628D2C8D815757785BBA75D9DB4A9.
Fixture evidence role is IMPLEMENTATION_PREFLIGHT_ONLY_NOT_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE. Re-audit reads and independently checks it but executes no code.

V5R_X01_cross_file_binding_and_executabi.objective: Prove the repair is one exact algorithm everywhere rather than compatible prose variants.
requirements: Every V5 registry, map, protocol, advancement, gate, claim, memo, fixture, and freeze reference to the repaired diagnostic resolves to one canonical algorithm ID, schema ID, fixture ID/path/hash, context list, denominator table, veto rule, and missingness rule.
Arrays and enumerations repeated across files are exact in value, order, spelling, type, and cardinality. Prose summaries cannot override or weaken the canonical machine-readable definition.

All algorithm references resolve; no stale Candidate V4 execution path, old undefined rescale phrase standing alone, placeholder, TODO, optional default, inferred tolerance, dangling JSON pointer, or contradictory status remains.
The V5 freeze binds every artifact and fixture byte; every artifact binds the V4 parent freeze, V4 failed edge adjudication, and exact V5 route consistently.

independent_fixture_review_procedure.failure_action: Any missing edge case, ambiguous expected value, unconsumed raw row, hash mismatch, exception, or external dependency is blocking and denies implementation release.
